data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in order (Attractions, destination, select suggestion, date, Search, filters, open attraction and check availability). It adds a few extras (an ticket_counts parameter and an "Explore destinations" option), and it names no guests parameter, but it is concrete enough to automate.
